u1-priya.speaker: Priya Natarajan, Channel 7 News
u1-priya.text: Can you confirm what caused the evacuation, whether anyone was hurt, when residents will be allowed back in, and what the company is doing for the students who are outside right now? We would like a statement by 9:00 a.m. and would welcome someone on camera at 11:00.

u2-post.speaker: Circulating social post
u2-post.text: The Halden on campus has been CONDEMNED and is collapsing. Two students hospitalized. Tallgrass Student Living knew. Share this.

u2-request-4471.speaker: Resident, Unit 312
u2-request-4471.text: Cracks in the hallway wall on 3 by the east stairs, new since last week.

u2-request-4502.speaker: Resident, Unit 318
u2-request-4502.text: The crack is longer now and my door won't close unless I slam it.

u2-request-4539.speaker: Resident, Unit 312
u2-request-4539.text: Third time. The crack goes into the ceiling now. Can someone please look at it.

u2-mother.speaker: A mother in Dayton, on Facebook
u2-mother.text: nobody from the company will answer.

u2-priya.speaker: Priya Natarajan, Channel 7 News
u2-priya.text: We have the maintenance ticket screenshots. Did Tallgrass Student Living ignore warnings about this wall for three weeks? Will someone go on camera at 11:00?

u3-contractor.speaker: Kessler-Brandt Construction
u3-contractor.text: Kessler-Brandt Construction built The Halden to the engineer's drawings and passed every city inspection. We are confident in our work.

u3-engineer.speaker: Larkin & Pell Structural Engineers
u3-engineer.text: Our design was sound. We are reviewing whether construction matched the design.

u3-university.speaker: University of Cincinnati (statement within the fictional scenario)
u3-university.text: The Halden is a privately owned and operated property and is not affiliated with the University. Student Affairs is assisting affected students with information about temporary housing.

u3-dana.speaker: Dana Whitlock, chief executive (proposed wording, not issued)
u3-dana.text: we were as surprised as anyone.
